annotations.title: Get My Cash Gifts and Transfers

description: Use this when the couple asks about their own cash gifts or the transfers (payouts) to her bank. The signed-in couple's own cash gifts on their Zola registry, from her cash funds and from the items of other stores that guests pay in cash: whether the bank account for cash gifts is set up, why transfers are off and which details Zola needs, the cash ready to transfer, each cash gift with its status, and each bank transfer with its arrival date or failure reason. A surprise gift that is not revealed shows only its status. Gives no bank account number. For all gifts, use zola_get_my_gift_tracker. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read). Do not use for how cash funds and their fees work on Zola in general: use zola_search_help_articles.
name: zola_get_my_cash_gifts_and_transfers

outputSchema.description: The cash fund of the signed-in couple: the bank account state, the cash gifts, and the transfers

can_transfer_cash.description: False when this user does not own the registry (only the owner partner can transfer), or when no cash is ready

exists.description: False when the account has no wedding registry

gifts.description: The cash gifts. No giver or value of a surprise gift that is not revealed

hidden_surprise.description: A surprise gift that is not revealed: only the status

on_hold_until.description: A fraud check holds the gift until this date

status.description: available: ready to transfer. pending, processing: transfer in progress. completed: transferred. problem, review: see the gift tracker

transfer_value_cents.description: The amount that goes to the bank account

value_cents.description: The gift. Null for a surprise gift that is not revealed

gifts_truncated.description: True when gifts gives only the 50 newest: see all in the gift tracker

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

payout_account.description: Null when the couple has no bank account for cash gifts

disabled_reason.description: Why transfers are off. Null when they are not off

fields_needed.description: The details to give on zola.com

set_up.description: A bank account for cash gifts exists and its details are sent

transfers_enabled.description: Null when Zola does not know the state of the transfers

verification_required.description: Zola needs more details before it can transfer cash

transfers.description: The bank transfers of the cash gifts, newest first. No bank account number

failure_reason.description: A code for the failure. Tell the couple what_happened and next_step, not this code

next_step.description: A failed transfer: what the couple can do, in the words of the Zola email

what_happened.description: A failed transfer: what happened, in the words of the Zola email. Null when Zola has no text

transfers_truncated.description: True when transfers gives only the 20 newest

title: Get My Cash Gifts and Transfers
